lines.en: I make my way to the second half of town to visit Tojo Ramen and, by association, Tsuneyo Tojo.
lines.zh: 我前往城市的另一半，去拜访 Tojo Ramen，顺便也拜访 Tsuneyo Tojo。

lines.en: : You just thought of my name.
lines.zh: : 你刚刚想到了我的名字。

lines.en: Anyway, Tsuneyo and I spend the night awkwardly discussing the things she likes about noodles because, let's face it, that's the only conversation topic this girl is able to hold at the moment.
lines.zh: 总之，Tsuneyo 和我度过了一个尴尬的夜晚，讨论她喜欢面条的哪些地方——因为说白了，这是这姑娘目前唯一能聊下去的话题。

lines.en: It's a bit stressful trying to keep up with her on the subject matter, but I distract myself with the glorious comfort food that is this greasy bowl of flavor.
lines.zh: 想在这个话题上跟上她有点吃力，不过我用这碗油腻香浓的治愈系食物分散了注意力。

lines.en: Tsuneyo must notice it as well as something resembling a smile spreads across her face each time I take a sip of the broth.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 一定也注意到了，因为每当我喝一口汤，她脸上就会浮现出类似微笑的东西。

lines.en: I'll never stop being surprised at how easy it is to make some people happy.
lines.zh: 让某些人开心居然这么容易，我永远都会为此感到惊讶。

lines.en: If sitting at a counter and scarfing down the food she makes is all it's going to take for me to grow closer to her, I'll gladly come here any night of the week.
lines.zh: 如果只要坐在吧台前狼吞虎咽她做的东西，就能让我跟她更亲近，那我乐意一周里任何一晚都来这儿。

lines.en: I just wish she didn't work in such a horrible part of town.
lines.zh: 我只是希望她别在城里这么糟糕的地段工作。
